I will plant improved hybrid seed because it gives better yields than the local seed, and that is what I have been using in recent years. I will not use pesticides or herbicides because they are too expensive for a small plot like this—I will weed with my family by hand. I will not irrigate because I rely on the rains; I have no water pump or irrigation system. My family will spend many days on this plot doing planting, weeding, and harvesting, and I may need to hire a few days of labor when the work is heaviest.
